name: 1337 C/C++ Development Container
postCreateCommand: echo 'Welcome to 1337 C/C++ Development Container!' && echo 'Checking installation...' && zsh --version && gcc --version && clang --version && make --version && cmake --version && valgrind --version && python3 --version && (pip3 show c-formatter-42 || pip3 install --trusted-host pypi.org --trusted-host pypi.python.org --trusted-host files.pythonhosted.org c-formatter-42 || echo 'c_formatter_42 will be available after container start')
